Subject: 🚀 Big News: On-Call Is Getting a Refresh!

Hey team! 👋

We've got exciting news to share! Starting **June 2**, our on-call rotation is moving from weekly shifts to **every 3 days**. That means fresher coverage, less burnout, and more balanced weeks for everyone!

Our amazing on-call pool now includes **9 talented engineers**, and we're thrilled to recognize the extra effort with a **$150 bonus per shift**! 🎉 That's real appreciation for the incredible work you do keeping our systems humming.

Here's what to expect:
✨ Shifts now run every 3 days
✨ Clear handoff notes at every changeover
✨ A $150 bonus for each shift you cover

Have questions? Reach out to your team lead or drop a note in the #on-call channel. We're here to help you succeed!

Let's make this our best rotation yet! 💪

Cheers to you all,
The Engineering Leadership Team 🌟
